title: Kid Contest Entry
scenario: A school-age art contest asks for your child’s full name, school, and birthdate publicly.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Kid Contest Entry: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Children’s personal details should be minimized online.
